name: M7.Presentation.record_mono
statement: ∀ (κ σ τ : Type) [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ] (k : κ) (s s1 : σ) (t t1 : τ), s ≤ s1 → t ≤ t1 → M7.Presentation.mk k s t ≤ M7.Presentation.mk k s1 t1
guidance: Use Prod.Lex.toLex_le_toLex or its partial-order variant twice. Equal outer coordinate reduces to the inner lex order; weak coordinate inequalities imply lex weak order. This proves that independent coordinate minima give the least pair. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.
